items:
Home Highlights
- Private & Convenient Beach Access
- Access to Rosemary Beach's Amenities
- Gulf Views
- Private Pool (Pool can be heated for an additional $40 per day from October 1-May 1)
- Outdoor Fireplace
- 7 Adult Bikes

Welcome to YOLO, a beautifully designed coastal retreat nestled on the south side of 30A in Rosemary Beach, offering breathtaking ocean views and an unbeatable location just steps from the Gulf. A private gate from the home’s pool and entertaining courtyard opens directly onto Rosemary Beach’s private Beach Access A boardwalk, providing stroller- and wheelchair-friendly access and an incredibly short walk to the sugar-white sand and emerald waters.

Guests of YOLO enjoy access to Rosemary Beach’s exceptional amenities, including a private beach (with the option to host beach bonfires through RB), a well-appointed fitness center with classes such as yoga and massage services, three outdoor community pools, a heated indoor pool, and the beloved Rosemary Beach Racquet Club featuring eight lighted Har-Tru clay courts. The home is also perfectly located within walking or biking distance of Rosemary Beach’s charming shops, restaurants, and entertainment.

YOLO Main House

The main house offers four bedrooms and four and a half bathrooms, thoughtfully designed for comfort, convenience, and relaxation. Upon entering, you’re welcomed by a stylish foyer with custom artwork and storage for your everyday beach essentials. An elevator services all three levels, making it easy to move luggage, groceries, and vacation gear throughout the home.

The first floor features a serene King guest suite with a luxury mattress, en-suite bathroom, and peaceful views of the pool, spa, and ocean beyond—perfect for guests who prefer easy access to the outdoor living space. A charming bunk room nearby includes two Twin XL over Twin XL bunks, a private en-suite bath, and Smart TV, making it ideal for kids or teens. A full laundry room is also located on this level with direct access to the private courtyard.

Step outside to the heart of YOLO’s outdoor living area, where a resort-style pool and spa, outdoor fireplace, grilling station, and alfresco dining for fourteen await. From the courtyard, guests enjoy rare, direct access to Rosemary Beach’s private boardwalk—just a few steps from the sand.

The second floor offers a peaceful sitting area with a balcony overlooking the community park, perfect for enjoying a quiet morning coffee. The spacious primary suite features a luxury king bed, spa-inspired bathroom with double vanity, soaking tub overlooking the ocean, and an oversized marble shower. The suite’s expansive wraparound balcony provides some of the home’s most stunning ocean, pool, and spa views. An additional king guest suite on this level includes its own en-suite bath and private balcony overlooking the pool.

The third floor is the true showstopper of YOLO. This open-concept living, dining, and kitchen space showcases sweeping panoramic ocean views framed by Rosemary Beach’s iconic rooftops. Whether you’re preparing coastal meals in the fully equipped kitchen, relaxing on the plush sectional, or gathering around the dining table, the scenery is unforgettable. Step outside onto the massive wraparound balcony to enjoy ample seating and a charming bed swing—ideal for afternoon naps, sunset cocktails, or simply listening to the waves.

YOLO Carriage House

The separate carriage house offers additional privacy and flexibility for extended family or guests. Accessed through the private courtyard or Windward Lane, it features a private ocean-view balcony—a perfect spot for morning coffee or evening drinks.

Inside, the carriage house welcomes you with a full kitchen and vaulted ceilings, creating an open and airy feel. The living area includes comfortable seating, bar dining, and a large Smart TV. A unique loft space adds fun and functionality, featuring a queen bed, a cozy twin “fort” nook for kids, and a TV for streaming. The king primary bedroom offers a luxury mattress and a private en-suite bath, along with a stackable washer and dryer for added convenience.

YOLO Cottage & Carriage House offers the perfect blend of luxury, comfort, and location, making it ideal for multi-family vacations, beach retreats, and unforgettable coastal getaways. We look forward to welcoming you to Rosemary Beach and hosting your stay at YOLO. 🌊✨
